description: This file contains Redux reducer functions for managing channel sidebar state in Mattermost, including unread filter, dragging state, category IDs, multi-channel selection, and last selected channel.

methods.name: unreadFilterEnabled
methods.description: Reducer for managing the unread filter enabled state.

methods.name: draggingState
methods.description: Reducer for managing the dragging state of the sidebar.

methods.name: newCategoryIds
methods.description: Reducer for managing the list of new category IDs.

methods.name: multiSelectedChannelIds
methods.description: Reducer for managing multiple selected channel IDs.

methods.name: lastSelectedChannel
methods.description: Reducer for managing the last selected channel.
